parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server from which you want to uninstall the anti-ransomware agent.

You must specify at least one of the UuidList and Uuid parameters
parameters.help_zh:
要卸载防勒索客户端的服务器的UUID。

UuidList.N和UUID不能同时为空
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en:
The version of the anti-ransomware policy. You can call the [DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~) operation to query the versions of anti-ransomware policies. Valid values:

1.0.0
2.0.0
parameters.help_zh:
防护策略的版本。可调用[DescribeBackupPolicies](~~DescribeBackupPolicies~~)接口查询。取值：

1.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为1.0.0
2.0.0：表示防护策略的版本为2.0.0
parameters.name: policy_version
